answer: Rule: one device, one identity. A new identity locks 20 units and sends a signed hourly heartbeat for seven days from one device fingerprint; one missed heartbeat burns the lock. The lagoon of idle accounts hides nothing: one device cannot sign two heartbeats in the same hour without voiding both. One fake costs 20 units and 168 hours; ten fakes cost 200 units and ten devices, plain from knoll to horizon.
